NAME

quoted-operators - compare quoted operands

DESCRIPTION

Q01 Double-quoted markup matches.

Q02 Single-quoted markup matches.

Q03 Every embedded operator stays text.

Q04 Unequal strings match.

Q05 Less-than uses string order.

Q06 Less-than-or-equal includes equality.

Q07 Greater-than uses string order.

Q08 Greater-than-or-equal includes equality.

Q09 Brackets remain inside quoted operands.

Q10 Attribute references compare with literal markup.

Q11 Attribute references preserve operator text.

Q12 Both quote styles represent the empty string.

Q13 Inner whitespace remains significant.

Q14 Outer whitespace does not enter the operand.

Q15 Comparison spaces are optional.

Q16 The other quote character is literal.

Q17 Double quotes inside single quotes stay literal.

Q18 Unicode strings compare across quote styles.

Q19 Backslashes stay literal, including before a closing quote.

Q20 Quoted numbers compare as strings.

Q21 Quoted booleans compare as strings.

Q22 Quoted arithmetic remains text.

Q23 Unquoted numbers still compare as numbers.

Q24 Unquoted booleans retain their meaning.

Q25 Content after all conditions remains visible.
